cross_account_stress_formula.price_basis: mark-price stress; Hyperliquid uses mark price for margining/liquidation

distance_definition.uniform_long_down_move: smallest d in [0,1) such that all modeled long-perp mark prices are multiplied by (1-d) and cross account equity <= total maintenance margin
distance_definition.general_stress_ray: smallest nonnegative scalar lambda along a preregistered relative-return vector that reaches the liquidation condition

required_inputs: actual cross-margin perp notionals by BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB from the implementation plan
collateral_rules: Do not assume ordinary spot balances are cross-margin collateral.
Do not assume Portfolio Margin is enabled.
If implementation accounting cannot state cross-account equity and actual perp notionals, liquidation evidence fails closed.
A route/candidate that cannot fund its required perp margin from the explicit implementation plan fails implementation feasibility before promotion.
scope_rules: LEVERAGE-0040 remains long-only; negative perp notionals are rejected by this model version.
The model evaluates margin/liquidation mechanics only and does not choose leverage multiplier, route, alpha, funding signal or operating drawdown budget.
Tier metadata are read only from the frozen pre-result snapshot; live API changes do not silently change this study.
validation_requirements: Tier maintenance-margin continuity at every frozen lowerBound.
Single-position first-tier bisection distance matches Hyperliquid official liquidation-price formula within deterministic tolerance.
Cross-asset maintenance is the sum of per-position tier maintenance requirements under the same stressed mark vector.
Malformed/missing asset, tier, equity or notional input fails closed.
No modeled liquidation in mandatory LEVERAGE-0040 historical/synthetic stress is required for promotion.
